name: Nexu Tool Call Guard
description: Restricts local browser and computer automation to desktop main sessions, keeps host command execution out of channel- and automation-driven runs, fences writes to runtime-critical paths and reads of credential paths, and breaks infinite tool-call retry loops when a model repeatedly fails argument validation.

threshold.description: Consecutive same-tool validation failures (with no argument progress) before further calls are blocked. Minimum 2, default 3.

fence.description: Roots that no session may write to through file tools. Falls back to OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR / NEXU_HOME when absent.

stateDir.description: OpenClaw state directory. Its extensions/, openclaw.json, and skills/ are fenced.

nexuHome.description: Nexu home directory holding user config, ledgers, and compiled snapshots.

userSkillsDir.description: Directory of user-authored skills that the runtime hot-loads. Defaults to ~/.agents/skills.

hostExecution.description: Per-bot opt-out from the default host-execution restriction, keyed by bot id. Only bots that changed a default are present.

controllerUrl.description: Loopback origin of the Nexu controller, used to report automation blocks so the owning schedule can surface them.
